decisions.reason: As a renamed and improved version of an already well-accepted trommel screen in a core application, it is very likely to remain in the portfolio unless replaced by a direct successor.
A multi-model mobile flail shredder line fits the firm's main mobile recycling machinery business and, after several years on the market, would normally be kept as part of the core range.

The mobile high-speed grinder is close to the firm's established customer needs in green waste and biomass processing, so a mature machinery maker would usually continue it rather than exit after initial development costs were absorbed.

The stationary electric fine shredder is somewhat more niche, but it supports the firm's strategy toward efficient, resource-saving stationary solutions and is therefore still more likely to be retained than withdrawn.
